title: Invalid Transactions
summary: Identify transactions that are possibly invalid if the transaction amount exceeds $1000, or if it happens within 60 minutes of another transaction with the same name but in a different city.
statement: Identify transactions that are possibly invalid if the transaction amount exceeds $1000, or if it happens within 60 minutes of another transaction with the same name but in a different city. Transactions are provided in an array as comma-separated values, including the name, time (in minutes), amount, and city of each transaction. Return a list of these potentially invalid transactions in any order.
constraints: A transaction is invalid above 1000 or near a same-name different-city transaction.
Return invalid original strings in any order.
hints: Parse each transaction into name, time, amount, and city while retaining its original string.
An amount above 1000 immediately marks it invalid.
Otherwise compare it with other entries for equal name, different city, and time difference at most sixty.
The pairwise predicate exactly covers both invalidity rules and preserves duplicates by index.
editorial: The pairwise predicate exactly covers both invalidity rules and preserves duplicates by index.

tests.explanation: Both Alice transactions conflict within thirty minutes across cities.
Only the amount-1200 transaction is invalid.
